title: Create workflows directly from the prompt

figma.visual_check: not_applicable: service/API only; D-16 owns presentation

status.publication: Stacked PR against brief/f-06; exact remote head and CI results are recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.reason: Owner-approved unmerged stack supersedes origin/main start. F-06 is the branch parent, not a runtime activation dependency. No F-08 work.

activation.readiness: The registered service must own the current open database and have the existing high-tier composer configured. No conversation or attachment capability dependency.

implementation: Bounded authenticated job API with project-scoped stable request IDs, exact original specification, durable progress and cancellation.

Reuse composePersistedFlow, baseline provenance/catalog snapshot, existing high-tier client and validated canonical draft attachment. Journal creation and job binding commit together before provider calls.

Atomic flow/version/result attachment creates only a populated disabled draft and never enables, publishes or executes it. Whole-graph traversal rejects candidates without a piece action, including empty loops and routers.
Timeout, shutdown and restart retain the prompt and known IDs; late results are fenced. Exact replay returns the existing outcome; only an explicit new request ID retries terminal work.

acceptance.evidence: Queued/running/completed/restarted replays use one model call, journal, flow and version; changed specification conflicts; requestId query recovers a lost response.

acceptance.check: Original specification and interrupted/final identity survive restart
acceptance.evidence: On-disk close/reopen preserves exact whitespace and constraints, completed IDs and interrupted composition IDs. Recovery performs no model calls. Old workers cannot attach late drafts.

acceptance.check: Populated disabled draft or useful blocker, never empty success
acceptance.evidence: Actual composer validates populated and nested-piece graphs; trigger-only, empty loop/router and report_blocked paths create no flow; unknown pieces fail validation; no runs created; canonical activation readiness still rejects unavailable pieces.

acceptance.check: Cancellation, timeout and failed persistence do not multiply drafts
acceptance.evidence: Queued/running cancellation, ignoring-abort providers, watchdog timeout, journal-link failure before provider work and result-write rollback all retain truthful terminal receipts.

acceptance.check: Authentication, capability/provider identity, bounds and isolation
acceptance.evidence: Actual panel-authenticated HTTP server, default-off/unconfigured/mismatched-provider matrix, CORS/no-store, UTF-8/body/prompt/key/queue limits and project-scoped read/cancel/recovery.

verification.guards: Normal pre-commit guards and related tests are required; their results are recorded in the PR description.
verification.full_suite: Exact pushed-head CI is recorded in the PR description, not inferred from affected tests.

shutdown_storage_regression.green: Included in final focused and affected runs; unwritable interruption storage cannot prevent abort or allow a late draft.

empty_scaffold_regression.green: Final suites cover empty loops/routers as blockers and nested piece actions as populated drafts.

data_plane_audit.resolution: Reviewed creator-only version access and registered it with the existing audit. A capture-canary runtime test and rejecting whole-version mutation verify that receipts, replay and later prompts do not forward captured step data. All audit assertions are retained.

review_fix.finding_fixed: Runtime storage recovery and in-flight replay gating
review_fix.publication: Local correction, not pushed; original delivery counts above describe the reviewed head.

manual_checks.main_and_prs: Fetched main/open PRs before implementation; no competing F-07 service. Parent F-06 review fixes are pushed on PR #745 at the baseline above and have green exact-head full CI. Pinned A10/A11 source contracts checked against this stack.
manual_checks.visual: No visible UI changes or screenshot claimed. D-16 consumes this service; the old WorkflowsRoom creation handler is unchanged.
manual_checks.external_effects: Temporary databases, real local HTTP auth and fake model fixtures only. No paid inference, real daemon activation, user-data edits or deployment.

limitations: One worker per daemon/vault, not a distributed lease service. Startup recovery fails unfinished work conservatively instead of resuming an uncertain provider request.
Terminal retries require a new explicit request ID; the old key always retrieves its saved outcome. Rows/prompts are retained without automatic expiry to preserve idempotency.
Composition validates structure and available operations, not semantic fidelity to every natural-language constraint. Draft activation still uses existing readiness and execution gates.
The result contains creation IDs only; consumers must read current workflow state from the canonical API after later edits or deletion.
UI integration, live-model assessment and selected connection/library ingredients are outside this card. Explicit blocker details are bounded model text and must be rendered as plain text.
rollback: Disable the workflowComposition flag and future D-16 presentation; normal shutdown records interrupted work. Retain original prompts, additive job rows, canonical journals and drafts. Never replay accepted jobs or remove user data.
